findings.title: cancel() passes order.customer to giveBack, so coupons are never released
findings.why: place() records the order id via coupons.use(code, id), and giveBack only deletes when the recorded value equals its second argument. Passing the customer never matches, so a single-use coupon stays 'already used' after cancellation. README lines 46 and 56-57 require it to be given back. The added openspec change describes this exact fix, but its tasks are unchecked and the code and tests are unchanged.

findings.title: Proposal wrongly says the shipping code already ships free at exactly €50.00
findings.why: Before this change set, src/shipping.ts used `goods > FREE_SHIPPING_FROM_CENTS`, so goods of exactly 5000 cents were charged shipping. The proposal and design say the code already agrees and 'no code change', which is only true after the other change's `>=` fix. The note is misleading about the support report.
